profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At Oscar, we're building the best health insurance technology in the world, solving hard problems with phenomenal social impact.  I work on a team that creates tools to put information at the fingertips of Customer Service and other internal teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was a tech lead for the DFP Revenue Reporting team, our goal was to create reports for clients that helped them understand how their business operated across Google ad products.
● Developed and maintained critical infrastructure pipelines for live periodic client reports
● Processed extremely large scale logs data with MapReduce/Flume pipelines
● Leveraged column-based data stores (Java, Python, Dremel)

I also worked as a developer on the DFP frontend, with Google Web Toolkit (a Java based FE tool), launching numerous features including FE pages for a new ad serving functionality and timesaving workflow improvements.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Created visualization tool for events in distributed storage system using the Google Web Toolkit 
• Evaluated algorithms for management of a distributed system: how the frequency of status updates from system components impacts overall system throughput and latency

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: • Profiled performance of Intel Nehalem memory hierarchy

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted study of the trade-offs of high-level programming tools on streaming multi-core systems 
• Evaluated the Cell BE processor vs. the NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GPU for general purpose programs 
• Implemented parallel benchmarks Bitonic Sort, Binomial Options Pricing, and Smith-Waterman alignment with the RapidMind programming tool
